calendar.matters:
HEARING ON PETITIONER ANDY GARCIA FOR CHANGE OF NAME OF AN ADULT
Off Calendar Feb-09-2024 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This matter is on calendar this day for petition for change of name of petitioner Andy Garcia.

Dept: 505; Judge: Ronald Quidachay; Clerk: K. Valdes; Proceedings recorded by "For the Record" commencing at 9:16:07 a.m. and concluding at 9:18:17 a.m.(D505)

Petitioner Andy Garcia was present, placed under oath and testified via Zoom Video Conference.

The are no objections to the petitioner's change of name petition.

The Court grants the petitioner's present legal name of Andy Garcia is changed to Andy Serrano Perez.

The Court signs and executes the Decree changing name this day.
